description: This file defines the NoteService interface, which specifies the contract for managing notes within the application. It declares methods for creating, updating, retrieving, and deleting notes, as well as seeding sample data.

classes.name: NoteService
classes.description: Interface defining the service layer for note management, including CRUD operations and seed data creation.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new note using the provided NoteRequest data.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing note identified by its id with new data from NoteRequest.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a note by its unique identifier.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all notes.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a note identified by its id.

methods.name: seedSampleData
methods.description: Seeds the data store with a specified number of sample notes.
